caption: The drawing depicts an object that resembles a metal clamp or tool featuring decorative elements. The main part of the object is a horizontally positioned bird, rendered in shades of gray, with some areas highlighted in a coppery brown color. On the bird's back, there is a brown spherical object, possibly an egg. Below the bird, attached to the vertical section of the clamp, is a hemispherical, dome-shaped object, also colored copper brown. The clamp itself is an L-shaped metal bar with engraved, decorative patterns, and at the bottom is a threaded screw ending in a key-like shape with a cloverleaf cutout. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background with a thin, faint rectangular border near the paper’s edges. The coloring is minimal, focusing on grays and browns, with precise and delicate line work defining the details of the objects.
title: Sewing Bird
